action_family.contract_choice: Highest predicted depth at the declared horizon among currently eligible affordable contracts
action_family.exit_for_entry_screen: Matching fixed 60/90/120-minute clock with the frozen first-later-bid and validated terminal settlement law
tie_break: closer to ATM from the OTM side

architectures.count_source: computed_parameter_counts() over canonical built models and declared tensorizer dimensions
architectures.exit_heads_during_entry_screen: Present in the built parameter count but not optimized until the entry screen survives all signed kill conditions
architectures.horizon_models: One canonical scalar contract-head model per architecture and declared horizon; no uncounted multi-output head

four_independent.reason: Exceeds the measured 377-parameter ceiling and remains conditional on prior shared-head specialization

cache_reuse.law: Reuse the completed model-free whole-prefix/whole-chain cache after verifying its immutable receipt and population; width does not enter cached tensors or labels

conditional_exit_stage_if_primary_passes.label_scope: Remaining ITM-depth magnitude path within the entry's declared horizon
conditional_exit_stage_if_primary_passes.training_entries: Nested out-of-fold entries from the matching entry architecture and regime only

controls_and_reporting.bid_net: ask in, bid out, measured fees
controls_and_reporting.confidence: one-sided 95% with the complete declared family size
controls_and_reporting.family_formula: 4 architectures x 3 horizons x 3 depth thresholds x 3 trade caps x 2 risk modes x 3 selectors (model, matched, shuffled)
controls_and_reporting.matched_control: For every real-policy cell, reproduce its joint side x delta-quintile x premium-quintile composition on the same scored sessions, then sample timing/contracts without replacement and apply identical occupancy/cap rules
controls_and_reporting.mid_gross: clock exit mid * 100 - entry mid * 100; spread and fees both removed
controls_and_reporting.shuffled_null: Same architecture, folds, action thresholds, clock exits and caps, fitted only on the frozen shuffled outcomes

v5_composition_match_law.cells: same scored session x entry regime x option side x absolute-delta quintile x entry-ask-premium quintile
v5_composition_match_law.occupancy: exact 120-minute clock intervals must not overlap; same-minute re-entry remains forbidden
v5_composition_match_law.quintile_source: causal values from the initial 93-session training prefix only, frozen before economics
v5_composition_match_law.required_completeness: every model trade must receive an exact matched trade or kill condition 2 fails
v5_composition_match_law.sampling: deterministic hash order without replacement, excluding model trades

v5_corrected_bootstrap.family_choice: retain V4's complete pre-exit family size rather than narrowing multiplicity after fit
v5_corrected_bootstrap.fold_rule: absolute real and paired deltas versus both controls must each be positive in at least 4 of 5 chronological folds

controls_and_reporting.v5_primary_family: One corrected primary selector fixed before economics; its matched and shuffled controls remain conditional on kill condition 1

evidence_budget.ruling: The generous route authorizes comparison; the conservative route admits no architecture and must accompany every result

fit_reuse.policy_fit_gate: PERMITTED through load_reopening() and assert_fit_permitted() with all seven required kill conditions
fit_reuse.reason: The model and out-of-fold ranking remain valid; only activation was defective

folds.normalization: Mean and standard deviation fitted on the initial 93-session prefix only, frozen forward, with transformed values clipped to [-10,10]
folds.update_law: After a block is scored, its labels become eligible and the frozen model receives one incremental epoch on that block before the next score block

forbidden: hidden size other than frozen width 3
absolute prediction threshold at or above the label clip ceiling
whole-session top-N or percentile computed from the scored session
cutoff calibration from labels, P&L, spreads or trade outcomes

label.imbalance_weighting: Initial-prefix inverse-frequency per horizon/stratum, normalized to mean one and capped at 20, then frozen
label.loss: Per-horizon smooth-L1 beta 0.25 over every eligible contract; each horizon uses its own canonical scalar contract-head model
label.meaning: Maximum signed SPX points in the money reached after entry and within each declared horizon
label.training_transform: Clip each field to [-25,30] points and divide by 30

primary_kill_cell.failure_consequence: If measured gross mid-to-mid is non-positive, record a negative result and stop before matched control, shuffled economics, bid economics or exit fitting
primary_kill_cell.metric: mean gross mid-to-mid dollars per trade before fees
primary_kill_cell.pass_rule: at least one selected trade and mean gross mid-to-mid dollars per trade strictly greater than zero

selector.application: freeze one cutoff per fold, then walk each scored session minute by minute under the existing occupancy and trade-cap state
selector.fold_cutoff: k-th largest training-minute maximum where k = 2 * number of strictly earlier training sessions
selector.score_unit: maximum predicted 120-minute ITM depth among eligible contracts in each minute
tie_break: closer to ATM from the OTM side

purpose: Correct the pre-outcome V4 selector defect while reusing the unchanged valid width-3 fit and preserving all seven signed kill conditions
ranking_diagnostics_before_economics: Pearson correlation of real OOF predictions with actual 120-minute ITM depth
actual 120-minute depth mean and count in ten equal-count prediction ranks
real and shuffled counts with predicted depth at or above 25 points
real and shuffled prediction standard deviations

selector_attainability_gate.absolute_rule: refuse every absolute prediction threshold greater than or equal to the label clip ceiling
selector_attainability_gate.rank_rule: require a finite interior training-prefix rank cutoff strictly below the observed training maximum and strictly before every score session

shuffled_label_null.law: Within each newly eligible training block, permute the complete three-horizon outcome vector among candidates with the same option side and rounded 5-point moneyness node; each horizon model consumes its corresponding permuted component

v4_interpretation.defect_proof: absolute prediction threshold must be strictly below the clipped label ceiling: 30 >= 30
